info.name: CORE API — Full Backend Route Verification
info.description:
Generated from apps/api/src/routes/index.ts and the registered module route files on refactor/modules. The collection is safety-gated: mutating requests are skipped unless environment variable runMutations is exactly true. Generic assertions prove route reachability and absence of unhandled 5xx errors; they do not prove business correctness. Fill DTO-specific bodies and IDs before functional workflow runs.

Safety gate: every mutating HTTP method, including the Paystack webhook, is skipped unless environment variable runMutations is exactly true. Successful login automatically stores accessToken and refreshToken when the response is AUTHENTICATED.
A 404 for a missing record is allowed; the route-not-found fallback specifically returns a message beginning `Route METHOD URL not found`, which the smoke assertion distinguishes.

Functional examples: source-verified DTO payloads are provided for the core student, guardian, staff, branch, class and subject setup workflow. Some endpoints remain route-inventory entries because their DTOs require additional module-specific inspection; do not treat an empty body as a valid test case.

exec: pm.test('Login response is JSON', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').to.include('application/json'); });
if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) {
const body = pm.response.json();
const data = body && body.data;
if (data && data.status === 'AUTHENTICATED' && data.tokens) {
pm.environment.set('accessToken', data.tokens.accessToken);
pm.environment.set('refreshToken', data.tokens.refreshToken);
console.log('Captured authenticated session tokens into the active environment.');
} else { console.warn('Login did not return AUTHENTICATED; it may require persona or school selection. Resolve that flow before protected requests.'); }

request.description: Authenticate a platform administrator on the platform host. Captures platformAccessToken and platformRefreshToken.

exec: pm.test('Login response is JSON', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').to.include('application/json'); });
if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) {
const body = pm.response.json(); const data = body && body.data;
if (data && data.status === 'AUTHENTICATED' && data.tokens) {
pm.environment.set('platformAccessToken', data.tokens.accessToken);
pm.environment.set('platformRefreshToken', data.tokens.refreshToken);
console.log('Captured platform session tokens.');
} else { console.warn('Platform login did not return AUTHENTICATED; check platform membership / school selection.'); }

const isMutation = !['GET','HEAD','OPTIONS'].includes(method);

pm.execution.skipRequest();
if (pm.response.code === 404) {

const message = (body && body.message) || '';
pm.test('404 is not the application route-not-found response', function () {
pm.expect(message).to.not.match(/^Route .* not found$/);
pm.test('No unhandled server error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500); });
if ((pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').includes('application/json') && pm.response.code !== 204) {
